analysis.title: US Equities Color: Squeezy (20 Oct 2026)
key_insights: S&P 500 closed +28bps at 7,712 with a market-on-close imbalance of $800mm to sell. Nasdaq 100 -13bps at 29,490, Russell 2000 +165bps at 2,773, Dow +102bps at 52,495. Small caps led (RTY > SPX > NDX).

Equities opened shakily on overnight weakness in the global tech complex (KOSPI -40%, a $150mn Korean neocloud IPO finished -32%), then stabilized through the afternoon. The desk described the move higher as squeezy, with short-heavy pockets at the top of the leader board.
Breadth was healthy, with about 400 S&P names finishing up. Volume was 15.828bn shares across US exchanges vs a year-to-date daily average of 18.545bn. ETFs were 32% of the tape.

The GS floor rated activity 4 on a 1-10 scale and finished +3% better to buy on muted notionals. Info Tech volumes were -15% vs the 10-day average. Per Bartlett, the flow picture was not convincing, with a net seller of Semis/AI into the bounce, at a slower pace than the prior week.
Resolution headlines spurred an oil selloff (WTI -180bps to $101.79) and an equity rally. VIX fell 613bps to 17.31, the 10Y yield was 5.1126%, gold 4,123, DXY 101.72, Bitcoin +73bps at $82,498.

Brazil was the central derivatives theme ahead of Sunday's runoff election. 1.25mm EWZ calls traded vs a 1-day average of 735k and a 5-day average of 430k, with desk flows heavily tilted to buyers of upside.
Key earnings ahead: SPCX tonight and META tomorrow. The SPX implied move through the end of the week is 0.99%.

market_movers.rationale: Post-bell +1.5% on a headline beat on revenue and EBITDA. Conference call at 4:30pm ET will focus on GW deployment, data center leasing, and Starlink direct-to-mobile. Market likely views it as a beat vs consensus but soft vs whisper.
Post-bell -5% and retesting the YTD low after a mixed print. Full-year operating margins were reiterated, but the full-year ad revenue outlook was lowered.
Post-bell -1.7%. Q3 EPS $2.54 vs $2.57 expected, revenue $17.9bn in line with consensus. Q4 guide is well below at $0.50-1.50 vs $1.88 expected, with $4.80 jet fuel expected in Q4.
Post-bell -11%. Procedure beat was modest against heightened expectations and points to the midpoint of the tightened guidance range.

earnings_insights: SPCX reported after the close (10/20): headline beat on revenue and EBITDA, stock +1.5% post-bell. The desk expects the market to see a beat vs consensus but soft vs whisper.
NFLX reported after the close (10/20): mixed print, full-year operating margins reiterated, full-year ad revenue outlook lowered. Stock -5% post-bell.
UAL reported after the close (10/20): Q3 EPS $2.54 reported vs $2.57 consensus, revenue $17.9bn in line with consensus. Q4 EPS guide of $0.50-1.50 vs $1.88 consensus. Q4 jet fuel expected at $4.80.
COF reported after the close (10/20): beat, stock +5% post-bell.
ISRG reported after the close (10/20): modest procedure beat vs heightened expectations, pointing to the midpoint of the tightened guidance range. Stock -11% post-bell.
SPCX earnings are tonight (call 4:30pm ET on 10/20) and META reports tomorrow (10/21).

macro_indicators.interpretation: Little changed on the day (-0.027bps as printed in the note).
Sold off on resolution headlines, helping the equity rally.

risk_factors: Flow picture was unconvincing, with muted notionals, Info Tech volumes -15% vs the 10-day average, and a continued net seller of Semis/AI.
Global tech weakness overnight (KOSPI -40%, Korean neocloud IPO -32%).
Q4 jet fuel at $4.80 weighs on airline guidance.
SPCX print may be soft vs the whisper number.
vol_and_positioning: SPX spot and vol popped together on the resolution news, then both trickled lower. Fixed-strike vols closed in the red.
Skew was crushed on the rally and flattened through the day, though it still closed firmly offered, normalizing after Friday's aggressive bid.
NDX fixed-strike vols and skew were bid on the spot underperformance.
A customer bought 10k SPX 27 Oct 7800 calls, then rolled them 1x2 to the 7850 strike. Flows tapered into the afternoon.
1.25mm EWZ calls traded vs a 1-day average of 735k and a 5-day average of 430k, with buyers of upside dominating.
SPX implied move through the end of the week is 0.99%.
Short pockets led the market higher, which the desk described as squeezy.
geopolitical: Resolution headlines spurred an oil selloff and equity rally (the note does not name the specific event).
Brazil runoff election on Sunday drove heavy EWZ call buying.
